item.title: Federal judge blocks USDA secretary's Christian notes to agency workers
item.description: Agriculture Secretary Brooke Rollins frequently discusses her religious beliefs and regularly posts excerpts of Christian scripture on social media, including on her official accounts.

media:content.media:title: Federal employees and religious freedom groups sued to stop Rollins' practice, saying it subjected USDA workers to “government-sponsored religious coercion.”

item.title: USDA delays grocery store rule after Mamdani appeal to Trump
item.description: The New York City mayor urged the president to delay new stocking standards for retailers authorized to accept food aid benefits.

media:content.media:title: President Donald Trump and New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani hold a joint news conference after a meeting at Gracie Mansion on Sept. 21 in New York City.

item.title: USDA policy shift would cut millions of people off food aid program
item.description: The Agriculture Department is reviving a plan that will require low-income people to take additional steps to qualify for the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program.
